persona.description: Who the agent sounds like, for the model ("a calm, plain-spoken service agent"). Default: a calm, plain-spoken agent.

words.description: The word budget of a generated line, per channel: a longer one is not said (its fixed line is).

voice.description: The most words a generated line may use on a call. Default 25.

chat.description: The most words a generated line may use in a chat. Default 40.

avoid.description: Phrases a generated line must not use ("unfortunately", "I apologize for the inconvenience"): told to the model, and a line that uses one anyway is not said (its fixed line is). Compared without regard to case.

checks.description: How strictly a framed line's span (prompts.yaml's `generate`) is checked by its words before anyone hears it. standard (the default): the checks of values and shape (no question, no other recipient, a negation of the content kept, the word budget, the phrases to avoid, no figure or name the content does not have), and the drift check, the decision model's judgement, for the rest: whose words they are, who does what to whom, a "no" or a condition left out. strict: every check besides, by its words: a clause of the content that says "no" or sets a condition left out (omitted), a person the content does not use, persons swapped, a he or a she of another gender (person); conservative, so it refuses more good summaries (the caller hears their exact words), for a regulated line or an owner who wants every guard. A whole generated line's checks are the same at both levels. The policy card says which each span runs. Here, for every span of the app; a line's or a span's own (prompts.yaml) wins.

description: style.yaml: how a generated line sounds. Only read when the app generates a line.
title: DialogWright style.yaml
